source: src/game/statusEffects.js STATUS_META const (canonical-data migration M497) + sunder/fury/weaken added for Emberveil 2 (used by skills and boss phases)

bleed.name: Bleeding
bleed.plain: Loses a small amount of HP every round from a bleeding wound.

poison.name: Poisoned
poison.plain: Loses HP every round; multiple doses stack on top of each other.

burn.name: Burning
burn.plain: Takes fire damage every round and has reduced protection against flames.

stun.name: Stunned
stun.plain: Skips the next turn and cannot act while the stun lasts.

haste.name: Hasted
haste.plain: Gets extra actions per round, acting more frequently than normal.

rally.name: Rallied
rally.plain: Deals more damage on every hit while this effect is active.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.plain: A protective shield absorbs incoming damage before HP is reduced.

block.name: Blocking
block.plain: Has a higher chance to block incoming attacks with a shield or weapon.

deflect.name: Deflecting
deflect.plain: The next hit that lands is partially or fully turned aside.

enchant.name: Enchanted
enchant.plain: Weapon carries a magical charge, dealing 25% more magic damage.

slow.name: Slowed
slow.plain: Acts less often each round, taking longer between turns.

taunt_totem.name: Taunt Totem
taunt_totem.plain: A totem draws enemy attacks toward itself, protecting the rest of the party.

regen.name: Regenerating
regen.plain: Recovers a small amount of HP at the start of each round.

marked.name: Marked
marked.plain: Receives extra damage from all sources while the mark is active.

blind.name: Blinded
blind.plain: Vision is impaired; attacks miss far more often than usual.

soulbind.name: Soul-Bound
soulbind.plain: A soul link connects this target to the caster; effects on one may transfer to the other.

curse.name: Cursed
curse.plain: A dark curse weakens this target, applying a mix of harmful effects.

silence.name: Silenced
silence.plain: Cannot cast spells or use any abilities that require speaking or channeling.

disarm.name: Disarmed
disarm.plain: Weapon has been knocked away; physical weapon attacks are unavailable.

root.name: Rooted
root.plain: Held in place and cannot move or change position in the fight.

holy_burn.name: Holy Fire
holy_burn.plain: Sacred flames scorch this unholy target, dealing light damage every round.

freeze.name: Frozen
freeze.plain: Encased in ice — cannot act this round.

confused.name: Confused
confused.plain: Disoriented — has a 50% chance to skip their next action.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.plain: Returns damage to any attacker that lands a hit.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.plain: Disoriented — attacks have a much harder time finding their mark (-25% hit chance) for the duration.

sleep.name: Asleep
sleep.plain: Cannot act for up to 2 rounds. Any damage instantly wakes the target. Allies will avoid attacking sleeping enemies.

sunder.name: Sundered
sunder.plain: Its armour is split open, so every weapon hit bites deeper.

fury.name: Furious
fury.plain: Lashing out much harder than normal.

weaken.name: Weakened
weaken.plain: Its blows have lost their strength.
